{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) and refunded orders
df_clean = df[(df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99) & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Check: are the two channels comparable in terms of customer_segment?
print("Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:")
print(pd.crosstab(df_clean['channel'], df_clean['customer_segment']))

# Compute conversion rates by channel
converted_by_channel = df_clean.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()
print("\nConversion rates by channel:")
print(converted_by_channel)

# Compute difference: email minus paid_search
conversion_diff = converted_by_channel['email'] - converted_by_channel['paid_search']
print(f"\nDifference in conversion rates (email - paid_search): {conversion_diff}")"}
